943: The camp is for all female bikers who want to learn something new, stop being afraid on the bike and gain confidence off-road. We'll teach you what and how to train and what to focus on. Pump track, trails, berms, corners, brake control, balance, and also awareness of the bike itself in the form of a short workshop. For the braver ones there are smaller benches, mini doubles and small drops. All in a one-day course for women, girls and young ladies. From this year we're e-bike friendly – if your e-bike is suitable for off-road riding, you can sign up with it too.
944: This year we have more training locations available. The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something on the pump track, in the skills centre and on the benches. On the pump track you'll practise pumping and flow, and for the more skilled we have small jumps ready. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast. In cooperation with the municipality of Tehov, the local park was built and developed for leisure activities, including cycling.

990: We're holding our fourth camp for men again in Zvánovice / Struhařov, in the beautiful surroundings of the Říčany and Struhařov forests. We'll focus on drops, descents and root sections, as well as riding over rocks. Dealing with critical situations off-road. Riding down or dropping whatever nature puts in front of your wheels, brake control, steep climbs and lots of other tricks you'll find useful on the bike – all in one package.
991: Struhařov and Zvánovice are a destination for many bikers, and the local forests and surroundings are full of surprises. There's practically everything you might encounter off the trails. We'll cover the basics of technique at the Master Horse Club grounds. The newly chosen venue is right next to rocky fields and several descents. On the way we'll come across rocks, fords, descents and climbs – all in the beautiful landscape of Josef Lada's country. For lunch we'll turn around at the Master Horse restaurant and head to the other side of the valley, where there's the option to ride some slightly sharper stuff.

1002: Women Tune Up with Bikeskills camp – Šembera trails
1003: This year's second camp will be a bit of a change for regular participants and for us. We'll visit the nearby Šembera trails, whose profile of family-friendly and easier trails makes them the ideal place to train trail riding. We'll cover everything from theory to practice. We'll always have one trail to practise on, closed to the public during our coaching, before moving on to the next trail. Of course we'll try not only the descent but also how to get back up the hill with the least effort. It will also include practising basic technique and an off-road ride around the area.
1004: The Šembera trails are located beyond the village of Tuchoraz, just 3 km from the centre of Český Brod. The trails are suburban and currently have no car park directly by the trails. Visitors are asked to use the car parks in Český Brod. Parking right by the trails or blocking someone's driveway in the nearby village won't do anything for the good reputation of cyclists and the project. Source: {1}www.semberskestezky.cz{2}
